description: Synthetic, non-real crime case data for developing a crime intelligence portal. The structured facts are intended to simulate the output of a future document upload -> information extraction -> cleaning pipeline.
important_note: All people, case IDs, vehicles, addresses, organizations, and events in this file are fictional and created only for software testing.
